asked.item: Blotato contacts TikTok to restore the banned shop account
Why TikTok banned the account (account-specific fact)

verdict.reason: The customer asks staff to contact TikTok and restore their banned account, which is a request for the team to act, and the reason for this specific ban can only be shown by the customer's own account; the help pages only give general ban causes and do not say Blotato can contact TikTok or restore accounts.
